name: slicksync
description: SlickSync - Nuvio and Stremio addon, user and credential management
author: SlickSync Team

scripts.server:private:watch: cp prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && bunx prisma generate && QUIET=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG=true AUTH_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET="temp-jwt-secret-key" ENCRYPTION_KEY="temp-encryption-key-32-chars-long" SLICKSYNC_PRIVATE_USERNAME="${SLICKSYNC_PRIVATE_USERNAME}" SLICKSYNC_PRIVATE_PASSWORD="${SLICKSYNC_PRIVATE_PASSWORD}" bun --watch --no-clear-screen server/index.js
scripts.server:public:watch: cp prisma/schema.postgres.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && bunx prisma generate && QUIET=false NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG=true AUTH_ENABLED=true DATABASE_URL="postgresql://slicksync:slicksync@localhost:5432/slicksync" JWT_SECRET="temp-jwt-secret-key" ENCRYPTION_KEY="temp-encryption-key-32-chars-long" bun --watch --no-clear-screen server/index.js
scripts.studio: cp prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && bunx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL="file:./prisma/sqlite.db" bunx prisma studio
scripts.studio:public: cp prisma/schema.postgres.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && bunx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL="postgresql://slicksync:slicksync@localhost:5432/slicksync" bunx prisma studio
